files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: Each station name ends with a direction word. Split the name into base_name (everything before the last word) and side (the last word). `result` should be a table with the columns station_code, base_name and side.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv; split each station_name at its last space into base_name (the text before it) and side (the last word); return station_code, base_name, side, one row per station.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
